maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from regulated electric, gas and steam delivery to customers in New York, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Regulated utility billing households and businesses in New York City, Westchester and O&R areas for energy service.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through rate-based utility investment in its grid, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated monopoly electric, gas and steam utility; customers in its territory cannot switch delivery provider.
